**Part A**
Total marbles: 3 red + 3 green + 2 blue = 8 marbles.
Three marbles are drawn without replacement.
Total possible outcomes = $\binom{8}{3} = \frac{8 \times 7 \times 6}{3 \times 2 \times 1} = 56$.
The complement of "at least two share a color" is "all three marbles have different colors", which means 1 red, 1 green, and 1 blue.
Number of ways to choose 1 of each color = $\binom{3}{1} \times \binom{3}{1} \times \binom{2}{1} = 3 \times 3 \times 2 = 18$.
Probability of all different = $\frac{18}{56} = \frac{9}{28}$.
Probability of at least two sharing a color = $1 - \frac{9}{28} = \frac{19}{28}$.

**Part C**
Start date: 2026-07-19 is a Sunday.
We need 89 business days, skipping weekends and the specified holidays:
- 2026-07-20 (Monday)
- 2026-08-07 (Friday)
- 2026-08-25 (Tuesday)
- 2026-09-16 (Wednesday)
- 2026-10-28 (Wednesday)
- 2026-11-11 (Wednesday)
All 6 holidays fall on weekdays.
89 business days requires $89 + 6 = 95$ non-holiday weekdays.
95 weekdays = 19 full weeks (since $19 \times 5 = 95$).
19 weeks after Sunday 2026-07-19 is Sunday 2026-11-29.
The 95th weekday is the Friday of that 19th week, which is 2026-11-27.
All 6 holidays occur on or before 2026-11-27, so exactly 6 holidays have been passed.
